question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 is " **scrubbed**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is referring to Mahalia Jackson's hands and how she used them in her performances.
 
• The verb "**scrubbed**" here suggests that **she had been doing hard physical work, most likely cleaning floors, and that her hands had become rough and calloused as a result**.
 
• The other options, "stubbed", "clubbed", and "grubbed", do not make sense in this context.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Stubbed (टकराना/चोट लगना) - Accidentally striking (one's toe) against something.
 
 
• Example: Jeremy stubbed his toe against the door in the dark.
 
 
 
• Clubbed (समूहित करना) - Gather or cause to gather into a group or mass.
 
 
• Example: She clubbed all the similar items together while organizing her room.
 
 
 
• Scrubbed (मंजन किया) - Rubbed hard so as to clean, especially with a stiff brush and often soap.
 
 
• Example: He scrubbed the dirty frying pan until it sparkled.
 
 
 
• Grubbed (खुदाई की) - Dug or burrowed in the earth, especially to uncover things.
 
 
• Example: The archaeologists grubbed carefully in their search for ancient artifacts.
